thread:
Noor: Hey team — quick one! Two bits of noisy good news: I got promoted to Senior PM today 🎉 and we’re also planning a tiny baby shower for Tess (due June). Would love ideas and who can help organize.

Dave: OMG congrats Noor!! so well deserved :tada: :clap:

Kai: Huge congrats!! Also yay Tess!! when are we thinking? lunchtime? after work? :party_parrot:

Tess: Honestly still processing both!! ❤️ Lunch on a weekday would be perfect for me. Thank youuuu everyone.

Alina: Congrats Noor!! You're 🔥. For the shower — office kitchen or rooftop? Rooftop is cute but weather risk.

Noor: Thank you all!! I can handle invites + cake ordering if folks can help with decorations and a tiny games list. Rooftop is tempting but maybe kitchen to be safe.

HR Bot: Event created: https://calendar.company.internal/e/1729001234-baby-shower (Wed June 12 · 12:30–1:15pm) — RSVP there or react in thread.

Noor: Quick poll for cake flavor (reply with emoji or react):
```
🍫 Chocolate
🍓 Strawberry
🍋 Lemon
🥕 Carrot
```

Dave: 🍫

Kai: 🍓

Alina: 🍋

Tess: I love carrot but I won’t say no to chocolate 😅

Noor: Awesome — cake tally so far: Chocolate 1, Strawberry 1, Lemon 1, Carrot 1. We'll do a half-and-half if it stays tied?

Kai: I can pick up decorations after 3pm the day before.

Alina: I’ll make a 5-minute baby shower quiz (silly) and bring confetti poppers.

Dave: Can I bring a playlist? low-key vibes.

Noor: Perfect — thanks folks. Also, if anyone wants to write 1–2 lines for a small card to Tess or a congrats note for my promotion, drop them here and I’ll print.

Kai: "So proud of you, Noor — onward and upward!"

Alina: "Tess — can’t wait to meet your little one. Sending all the good vibes."

Tess: You’re all the best. Feeling very loved :)

Noor: Truly appreciate it. Big day all around — will follow up with a short task list + calendar invite updates. :sparkles:
